## POST /admin-api/pep-audit

`reportPepDecisions`

**Push a remote PEP's decision records (#1827)**

A remote XACML PEP pushes the records of the decisions it made in its own process — `/protected` enforcements (`kind` `enforcement`) the AuthZEN evaluations it decided (`kind` `authzen`; never one it forwarded, which this service decided and recorded itself) and its reverse proxy's requests to a route (`kind` `proxy`, #1760, with `route` and the `status` it answered) — and each becomes one audit row, `xacml.remote.enforcement`, `authzen.remote.decision` or `xacml.remote.proxy`, read on GET /admin-api/audit. `instance` names the PEP process; every record carries `seq`, a positive integer increasing within that process, and the answer's `acknowledged` is the highest `seq` the batch carried, so the PEP removes everything up to it. Delivery is at least once: a record sent again is recorded again, and the row names the PEP, the instance and the seq that identify it. A record with no positive integer `seq` or an unknown `kind` is counted in `ignored` (STS-XACML-0288) and the rest are recorded. At most 500 records a push. The PEP must be registered in this realm (POST /xacml/pep/register) under the name its token's subject carries (STS-XACML-0287, 404). **The access token must carry `xacml:pep-audit`**: the PEP's own RFC 7523 self-assertion (`grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`, `iss` and `sub` its own username, its certificate's key registered on its entry) presented through the seeded public client `sts-remote-pep` with a DPoP proof by that key, so the token is bound to it (RFC 9449; over mutual TLS it is bound to the certificate as well, and through phase 3 of the PEP's token plan a certificate-bound token is still honoured where its certificate is presented). It is issued and honoured only while the PEP's entry is in the group roles.remotePepGroup names (REMOTE_PEPS); a token carrying anything else is refused here, and that scope reaches no other operation (STS-API-0147).

**Mirrors** `no console form — a remote PEP pushing what it decided; the records are read on GET /admin/audit` on the admin console.

Scope: `xacml:pep-audit`.

| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

## GET /admin-api/xacml

**The Policy Decision Point settings and current status**

The Settings tab on /admin/xacml, as JSON.

THIS IS THE ONLY FAMILY ON THIS SERVICE THAT ANSWERS A QUESTION ABOUT SOMEBODY ELSE'S BOUNDARY. Every other protocol here authenticates or provisions a person; this one is handed a subject who was authenticated somewhere else and asked whether they may.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-condition

`addXacmlCondition`

**Add a Condition to a rule**

A boolean expression evaluated AFTER the Target matches. **At most one per rule** — the schema allows exactly one, and the editor stops offering this on a rule that has one rather than offering it and then refusing, because an option that is offered and refused teaches a caller that the menu is not to be trusted.

It must evaluate to EXACTLY ONE BOOLEAN. A condition returning a bag, or an integer, is a static type error and the policy is refused at write time rather than going Indeterminate on every request.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-pep-cluster-member

`addXacmlPepClusterMember`

**Add a member to a remote PEP cluster**

Adds a PEP to a cluster (#1760): from its next poll it pulls the cluster's configuration with its own addresses. A name not yet registered may be listed. A PEP is a member of one cluster at most (STS-XACML-0271). A PEP holding a configuration of its own is refused unless `discard` is true (STS-XACML-0272); its own documents are then cleared and the answer's `discarded` carries them. Each member polls its own CAEP/RISC stream: it sends its registered name in the X-Iya-Pep-Name header, and a sign-out on that stream reaches that member. The member's routes must resolve with its own callback, &lt;publicBaseUrl>/.iya-pep/callback registered on each session route's client, and its listeners must not clash with what it reported; a refusal names the member and keeps its code.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `discard` | boolean, or string |  | true confirms that the PEP's own configuration is replaced by the cluster's. |
| `listeners` | map, or string |  |  |
| `listeners.{key}` | any JSON |  |  |
| `notifyUrl` | string |  | The member's own notify URL, which the nudge dials; empty for the one it registered with. |
| `pep` | string | yes | The member's name: a registered PEP's, or one not registered yet. |
| `publicBaseUrl` | string |  | The member's own public base URL, the origin a browser reaches it at; empty for the cluster's. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-policy

`addXacmlPolicyToSet`

**Add a Policy inside a PolicySet**

A PolicySet holds POLICIES; a Policy holds RULES. They are not two spellings of one thing, and asking for a rule on a policy set is refused rather than written somewhere it will not be read.

The new policy arrives with `deny-unless-permit` and no rules, which decides Deny. That is deliberate: this editor is LIVE, so a child added to the running root takes effect on the next request, and one that began permissive would be a hole opened by pressing Add.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |
| `policy` | string | yes | The directory entry name of the policy to edit — the `cn` under ou=policies, not the PolicyId inside the document. |

**200**: The operation was applied.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `problems` | list |  |  |
| `problems[]` | string |  |  |
| `what` | string |  |  |
| `why` | string |  |  |

**400**: The operation was refused; `errors` says why and nothing changed.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-policy-reference

`addXacmlPolicyReference`

**Reference a policy stored separately in the repository**

THIS IS HOW A PDP REACHES MORE THAN ONE DOCUMENT. Evaluation starts at the root policy and a `PolicyIdReference` is resolved against the repository WHEN A DECISION IS MADE, not when the document is loaded — so referencing a policy that has not been written yet is allowed and is not an error. An unresolved reference is reported on the decision instead, which is what keeps the order two policies are authored in from mattering.

The `ref` is the PolicyId INSIDE the other document, not its directory entry name.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |
| `policy` | string | yes | The directory entry name of the policy to edit — the `cn` under ou=policies, not the PolicyId inside the document. |
| `ref` | string |  | The PolicyId being referenced. Any URI. |
| `version` | string |  | An optional version constraint. Omit for no constraint. |

**200**: The operation was applied.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-rule-advice

`addXacmlRuleAdvice`

Something the PEP MAY do. **It is allowed to ignore this, and that is the whole difference from an obligation** — advice a PEP drops is a PEP behaving correctly, where an obligation it drops is half a policy enforced and reported as success.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-rule-obligation

`addXacmlRuleObligation`

**Add an obligation to a rule**

Fires when this RULE's Effect is the decision. An obligation is the half of a decision that says "yes, AND you must also do this", and section 7.2 makes it binding: a PEP that cannot discharge one MUST NOT grant the access. The remote PEP container implements that, and /admin/xacml/decide shows it — and it is the part implementations skip.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-target-anyof

`addXacmlTargetClause`

**Add a Target clause to a policy, a rule or a Target**

A `<Target>` is a list of clauses and **every one of them must match** — they are ANDed. Inside a clause the alternatives are ORed and inside an alternative the Matches are ANDed again, so the quantifier flips at each of the three levels.

That is why the element names read backwards from what they do: `AnyOf` holds `AllOf` holds `Match`, and the `AnyOf`s themselves are ANDed. Getting it wrong produces a policy that applies to more or less than was meant and never an error.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attributeId` | string |  | The attribute to read. A bare name or the `urn:sts:xacml:attribute:` prefix reaches the directory through the PIP; anything else must be in the request. |
| `category` | string |  | The attribute category. Defaults to access-subject. |
| `matchId` | string |  | The match function. Defaults to string-equal. THE DATATYPE FOLLOWS IT on both sides, so choosing the function settles the literal's type and the designator's together. |
| `path` | string |  | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |
| `policy` | string | yes | The directory entry name of the policy to edit — the `cn` under ou=policies, not the PolicyId inside the document. |
| `value` | string |  | The literal to test against. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/add-variable

`addXacmlVariable`

**Add a VariableDefinition to a policy**

Names an expression so several rules can share it — and so it is evaluated ONCE per request rather than once per use.

ITS SCOPE IS THE POLICY IT IS ON. A sibling policy in the same set cannot name it (section 5.24), which is why GET /admin-api/xacml/editor is the only reliable source of what a VariableReference at a given path may legally name.

It arrives holding a designator, because a VariableDefinition with no expression is a document that will not load. Replace it with any of the set-expression actions.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |
| `policy` | string | yes | The directory entry name of the policy to edit — the `cn` under ou=policies, not the PolicyId inside the document. |
| `variableId` | string |  | The name. Defaults to the next free `v<n>`. A duplicate is refused — the reader rejects a document defining one id twice, so allowing it here would write a policy this service cannot load back. |

## GET /admin-api/xacml/authzen

`getXacmlAuthzen`

**The AuthZEN API: its settings, attribute catalogue and callers**

Everything the AuthZEN tab on /admin/xacml draws: whether /access/v1 answers in this realm, how its callers authenticate (authzen.callerAuthentication), the AuthZEN settings, the attribute catalogue on the sts-authzen-api object with the vocabulary a row may use, and the members of roles.authzenPepGroup with the applications each may ask about and the access request callback URLs registered for it, and the realm's AuthZEN access requests (#1180). `?caller=<name or DN>` looks one caller up, in the group or not.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/authzen/approve-access-request

`approveAuthzenAccessRequest`

**Approve an AuthZEN access request**

Approves a pending access request (#1180) as the caller, after the access-control policy (action approve-access-request on resource authzen-access-request) permitted it — refused, among others, for the request's own subject. The approval is handed to the PEP, whose next evaluation the realm's policy decides afresh. Audited.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/authzen/set-attribute

`setAuthzenAttribute`

**Add or replace one row of the AuthZEN attribute catalogue**

Writes one authzenAttribute value on the realm's sts-authzen-api object, replacing the row for the same object and property. Refused for a row the catalogue's grammar refuses (STS-AUTHZEN-0010) and for one mapping onto a reserved identifier (STS-AUTHZEN-0011, 0012): a request-supplied attribute suppresses the PIP. Audited.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-authzen` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attributeId` | string | yes | The XACML attribute it is sent as. Never urn:sts:xacml:*, subject-id, resource-id or action-id, nor a bare directory name in a subject category. |
| `category` | string |  | access-subject, resource, action, environment (or another XACML category, or its URI); the object's own when empty. |
| `dataType` | string |  | string, boolean, integer, double, date, dateTime, time, anyURI, dayTimeDuration, yearMonthDuration, hexBinary, base64Binary, rfc822Name, x500Name, dnsName, ipAddress, or the type's URI; string when empty. |
| `description` | string |  | Free text for administrators. |
| `multiplicity` | one of `single`, `bag` |  | single (one value) or bag (a JSON array); single when left out. |
| `object` | one of `subject`, `resource`, `action`, `context` | yes | The AuthZEN object the property is on. |
| `property` | string | yes | The property's name, or a dotted path into a nested object (owner.country). For context, the member's name; context.application is reserved. |

**200**: The row as stored.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `changed` | boolean |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/authzen/set-callbacks

`setAuthzenCallbacks`

**Set the access request callback URLs of an AuthZEN caller**

Replaces the callback URLs registered for a caller (#1180, #1202): an application's appAuthzenCallbackUri, and appAuthzenCallbackConfig where a URL overrides authzen.callbackAttempts or authzen.callbackBackoffS; a person's or service account's stsAuthzenCallbackUri, which takes no override. An access request's callback.endpoint must match a URL exactly; this service never dials a callback URL taken from a request alone. https only, at most eight. One per line, or a URL followed by attempts=N and backoff=S. Empty clears them. Audited.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/create-from-template

`createXacmlPolicy`

**Create a policy from a template**

A template is a working, valid, evaluable policy in a shape people actually write — the first twenty clicks of the editor already made. `template` names one (see GET /admin-api/xacml/policies), `name` names the directory entry, and each parameter is sent as `p_<name>`; anything omitted takes the template's own default, so a call with only `template` produces the documented example.

`blank` is the one template that is not an example: it builds an EMPTY Policy, or an empty PolicySet with `p_kind=policyset` — which is the only way to create one of those without ALFA. An empty deny-unless-permit document DENIES rather than answering NotApplicable, so build it before making it the root.

A template BUILDS THE MODEL and the writer serializes it, rather than substituting into XML text — so a role called `a"b` cannot produce a document that will not parse.

The FIRST policy in an empty repository becomes the root, because a repository with a policy and no root decides nothing.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Names the DIRECTORY ENTRY. The PolicyId inside the document is a separate identifier and may be any URI. |
| `template` | string | yes | Which template. GET /admin-api/xacml/policies lists them with the parameters each takes. |

**200**: The operation was applied.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/create-pep-cluster

`createXacmlPepCluster`

**Create a remote PEP cluster, empty or from a registered PEP**

Creates a logical cluster of remote PEPs that share one configuration (#1760). With `from`, the PEP's reverse proxy, managed settings and listener definitions are copied to the cluster, the PEP becomes its first member (its publicBaseUrl and notify URL kept as its own addresses), its own documents are cleared, and the routes' generated policies are written again as pepc-&lt;cluster>-&lt;route>, marked @&lt;cluster>/&lt;route>; the PEP's old pep-&lt;pep>-&lt;route> policies are left in the repository, unreferenced. A name that is not 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, or one already taken, is STS-XACML-0270; a PEP not registered STS-XACML-0038, one already a member STS-XACML-0271.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

|---|---|---|---|

## GET /admin-api/xacml/decide

`getXacmlDecision`

**Ask the PDP about somebody and see the decision, which policies applied, and what the embedded PEP would do with it**

Everything the Try a decision tab on /admin/xacml draws. `subject`, `action` and `resource` are query parameters; with none of them it answers `asked: false` rather than deciding about nobody.

THE DECISION AND THE ENFORCEMENT ARE TWO DIFFERENT ANSWERS and both are here, which is the whole point of the page: the PDP says Permit, Deny, NotApplicable or Indeterminate, and the PEP then applies its bias and the obligation rule to get to allowed or refused. When a policy "is not working" it is nearly always because only one of those was being looked at.

This is NOT POST /xacml/pdp. That endpoint takes a JSON Profile request and is what a PEP calls; this builds a three-category request out of three parameters and is what a person asks.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/xacml` on the admin console.

The reply also carries `protocolEndpoints`: every endpoint of this family in the realm the call arrived in, as `{ name, methods, url }` (plus `route` for an HTTP endpoint, `transport` for a socket, and `registered: false` for a route the router no longer has).

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subject` | query | string |  | Who the decision is asked about. |
| `action` | query | string |  | What they would do. |
| `resource` | query | string |  | What they would do it to. |
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**200**: The decision, what applied, and what the embedded PEP would do.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/delete

`deleteXacmlPolicy`

**Remove a policy from the repository**

Deleting the ROOT leaves the repository deciding nothing, and the reply says so rather than letting it be discovered by a Deny.

AN APPLICATION'S FINE-GRAINED POLICY (#564) is deleted only when no application names it in appFgaPolicy — an orphan of a deleted application (`applicationPolicies` on GET /admin-api/xacml/policies marks which). The one an application still names is refused (`STS-FGA-0022`); reset it with POST /admin-api/applications/fga-reset-policy instead.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## POST /admin-api/xacml/delete-pep-cluster

`deleteXacmlPepCluster`

**Delete a remote PEP cluster**

Deletes a cluster and the policies generated for its routes (#1760). A cluster that still has members is refused unless `release` says what they keep: keep, and each registered member keeps a copy of the configuration as its own (its routes' policies generated again as pep-&lt;pep>-&lt;route>), or empty, and each is left with none (STS-XACML-0273). Every member is nudged.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `release` | one of `keep`, `empty` |  | keep or empty; required while the cluster has members. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/disable

`disableXacmlPolicy`

**Take a policy out of the decision without deleting it**

The point of having this separate from delete: a disabled policy is still there to be read, edited and put back, which is what you want while working on it — the editor is LIVE, so a policy being edited is a policy the PDP is deciding with unless it is off.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/disable-pep

`disableXacmlPep`

**Stop nudging a registered remote PEP**

IT DOES NOT STOP IT ENFORCING, and the reply says so rather than letting that be discovered. A remote PEP holds its own copy of the engine and its own copy of the policy; nothing in this API reaches into another process. What changes is that this service no longer dials it when the repository changes, so it converges only on its own polling interval.

Named with a `-pep` suffix rather than reusing `disable` because this endpoint dispatches on the action name across the whole family, and a second `disable` would be ambiguous between a policy and a PEP.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | The registered PEP's name. |
| `pep` | string |  | The registered PEP's name under the member GET /admin-api/xacml/peps calls it, ?pep= (2026-11-14). Send `pep` or `name`; both, they must name the same PEP. |

**200**: The operation was applied.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |

| `problems` | list |  |  |

**400**: The operation was refused; `errors` says why and nothing changed.

The three attributes of an `AttributeAssignmentExpression`. Its VALUE is the expression underneath it, edited with the set-expression and edit-value actions at the `...assignments.<n>.expression` path.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/edit-designator

`editXacmlDesignator`

Its category, attribute id, datatype and `MustBePresent`. **`MustBePresent` is the one that surprises people**: with it false an absent attribute is an empty bag, and with it true the whole expression is Indeterminate — which the combining algorithms then treat quite differently from a Deny.

`editXacmlMatch`

THE DATATYPE FOLLOWS THE FUNCTION. A Match whose literal is a string and whose designator is an integer does not type-check, so choosing the function sets both sides rather than letting them be picked independently and refused later.

`editXacmlObligation`

## POST /admin-api/xacml/edit-selector

ONE NAMESPACE BINDING AT A TIME, because the console this mirrors has no JavaScript and cannot grow a row: send `namespacePrefix` with `namespaceUri` to add or change one, and `namespacePrefix` with an empty `namespaceUri` to remove it.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/edit-variable

`renameXacmlVariable`

**Rename a variable, and every reference with it**

EVERY `VariableReference` NAMING IT IS REWRITTEN. The alternative — refusing to rename one that is used — is safe and useless, since a variable nobody references is the only one nobody wants to rename; and a rename that left the references behind would produce a document that does not load, so the write would be refused and nothing would change. The reply says how many references moved.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## GET /admin-api/xacml/editor

`getXacmlEditor`

**One policy as an editable tree, with what may legally be added at each node**

Everything the Policy editor tab on /admin/xacml draws. `?policy=<name>` chooses one; without it, the root.

Each node in `tree` carries `options.additions` — the elements XACML allows AT THAT POINT, computed against the real function library by the same code that validates the result. That is what makes this usable as an API and not only as a page: a caller can walk the tree, read the legal moves, and POST one, without a second copy of the grammar.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/xacml` on the admin console.

The reply also carries `protocolEndpoints`: every endpoint of this family in the realm the call arrived in, as `{ name, methods, url }` (plus `route` for an HTTP endpoint, `transport` for a socket, and `registered: false` for a route the router no longer has).

## POST /admin-api/xacml/enable

## POST /admin-api/xacml/enable-pep

`enableXacmlPep`

**Nudge a registered remote PEP again**

Puts it back into the set this service dials when the repository changes. A PEP that re-registers does NOT clear this by itself — a component an administrator stopped nudging must not be able to undo that by reconnecting.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | The registered PEP's name, which is the one its client certificate gave it. |
| `pep` | string |  | The registered PEP's name under the member GET /admin-api/xacml/peps calls it, ?pep= (2026-11-14). Send `pep` or `name`; both, they must name the same PEP. |

**200**: The operation was applied.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |

| `problems` | list |  |  |

| `what` | string |  |  |
| `why` | string |  |  |

**400**: The operation was refused; `errors` says why and nothing changed.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/forget-pep

`forgetXacmlPep`

**Remove a remote PEP from the register**

Removes the row in ou=peps. THE PROCESS IS UNAFFECTED: it may still be pulling and enforcing, and the next time it registers it simply appears again. Use it for a PEP that is genuinely gone; use disable-pep for one that is not.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/generate-pep-route-policy

`generateXacmlPepRoutePolicy`

**Generate a route's simple or public policy again**

Writes the policy a simple or public route of a registered remote PEP's reverse proxy generates (#1760), pep-&lt;pep>-&lt;route>, again from the route as stored: after it was edited in the policy editor or deleted. It is written as ALFA and stored through the repository's validating write, marked xacmlPepRoute = &lt;pep>/&lt;route>, never the root. A route choosing an existing policy has nothing to generate (STS-XACML-0264); a name held by a policy not generated for the route is STS-XACML-0267; an unknown route STS-XACML-0230. The answer's `written` is false when the policy already says what the route chooses.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | The registered PEP's name, as GET /admin-api/xacml/peps lists it. |
| `pep` | string |  | The registered PEP's name under the member GET /admin-api/xacml/peps calls it, ?pep= (2026-11-14). Send `pep` or `name`; both, they must name the same PEP. |
| `route` | string | yes | The route's id. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/import-alfa

`importXacmlAlfa`

**Create a policy from ALFA**

ALFA — the Abbreviated Language For Authorization — is the readable syntax for XACML: forty lines of XML are eight of ALFA. Send it as `alfa` and a name as `name`.

IT IS PARSED, CONVERTED AND STORED AS XACML XML. The repository holds ONE representation, because two would be two documents that could disagree — GET /admin-api/xacml/editor renders the ALFA back from the model whenever you want to read it.

EVERY ATTRIBUTE MUST BE DECLARED BEFORE IT IS USED. That is ALFA's own rule and it is the most useful refusal in the parser: a typo in an attribute name is otherwise a policy that quietly matches nothing, which looks exactly like a policy that is working and denying you.

ALFA IS AN OASIS COMMITTEE SPECIFICATION DRAFT, not a ratified standard — no conformance suite, no schema, no second implementation to disagree with. The contract offered is the one that can be kept: anything this service EMITS as ALFA it reads back, and the policy decides identically either way.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

| `name` | string | yes | Names the directory entry. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/issue-pep-certificate

`issueXacmlPepCertificate`

**Issue a remote PEP the certificate and private key for its HTTPS listener**

Generates a key pair and certifies it from the Remote PEP listeners (`pep-tls`) Issuing CA of THE REALM THE PEP REGISTERED TO — the realm this call is made in, because ou=peps is per realm — so a client that installed this service's Root CA verifies the PEP, and the chain says which realm vouched for it. A realm whose branch was built before that Issuing CA existed gets it added under its existing Intermediate; nothing already issued is replaced.

The PEP must be REGISTERED: its row is the one record that it exists in this realm. That is not a permission check on the PEP — registering is still not what lets it pull or enforce.

THE CERTIFICATE NAMES the PEP's registered name (where that is a DNS name), the hostname it reported on its registration or heartbeat (#1760; the name its derived notify URL looks for, so the nudge works on a fresh install), and the host of its notify URL, plus any `dnsNames` and `ipAddresses` sent. It certifies `serverAuth` and nothing else.

**THE PRIVATE KEY IS IN THIS REPLY AND NOWHERE ELSE.** This service records the certificate — its issuer's CRL and OCSP responder answer for it — and keeps no copy of the key, so nothing can read it back. To put the pair in the container, write `fullChainPem` (the leaf followed by its Issuing CA, the realm Intermediate and, since #1064, the service Root) and `privateKeyPem` to the files `PEP_HTTPS_CERT` and `PEP_HTTPS_KEY` name; the PEP picks up a pair written after it started. `anchorPem` is the service Root a client of that listener installs.

Issuing again REPLACES: the certificate it replaces goes on its issuer's revocation list as `superseded` (`replacedSerialHex`).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/issue-pep-credential

`issueXacmlPepCredential`

**Certify a remote PEP's own key as its RFC 7523 assertion key**

Certifies the public key in a remote PEP's own PKCS #10 certificate request (`csr`) from THIS REALM's Issuing CA and registers the leaf as the RFC 7523 (purpose=jwt) key of the PEP's entry, which is what lets the PEP sign its self-assertion for a DPoP-bound access token from `sts-remote-pep` (#1827's follow-up, phase 3). **This service never generates, sees or keeps the private key**: the PEP, or `tests/tools/pep-credential.js --assertion`, generates the key pair and sends only the request; no private value is written to the entry (`source` `issued-from-csr`).

The request's signature must verify with the key it carries (proof of possession, the PKCS #10 reader ACME, EST and SCEP use), and the key must be EC P-256 (ES256, preferred) or RSA of 2048 bits or more; anything else is refused naming the two. **The request's subject and names are ignored**: the leaf names the ENTRY, `urn:sts:sa:<name>`. Like any issued leaf it is in its Issuing CA's register, so its CRL and OCSP responder answer for it and revoking it on /admin/users refuses the grant.

`name` (or `pep`) is the USERNAME of the PEP's entry under this realm's ou=users — no registered ou=peps row is needed, because this is how a PEP is provisioned before it ever registers. The entry must exist (STS-XACML-0298), be a service account (STS-XACML-0299) and hold REMOTE_PEPS through the group roles.remotePepGroup names (STS-XACML-0301).

A new key is ADDED beside any the entry holds, up to pki.personSigningKeyMax valid ones, so a running PEP keeps working until it is moved onto the new key. `revokePrevious: true` revokes every other valid RFC 7523 key of the entry (cessationOfOperation) after the new one is written — before it, where the entry is at the cap; a revocation that fails is STS-XACML-0302 with the new key registered.

The answer carries the certificate, its chain, `fullChainPem` (through the Root), the `kid`, the `urn` and the `environment` the PEP is started with: `PEP_NAME`, `PEP_CLIENT_ID` and `PEP_ASSERTION_KEY` (the key file the caller kept). Audited as `xacml.pep.credential`, with no key material.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `csr` | string |  | The PEP's PKCS #10 certificate request, PEM or base64 DER, signed with the key to be certified (EC P-256 or RSA of 2048 bits or more). Its subject and names are ignored. |
| `days` | integer |  | The lifetime. Defaults to `pki.leafLifetimeDays`, and is shortened to the Issuing CA's own expiry. |
| `label` | string |  | A short name for the key on the entry's key list. Defaults to `remote PEP`. |
| `name` | string |  | The username of the remote PEP's entry under this realm's ou=users: a service account in the remote PEPs group. |
| `pep` | string |  | The same, under the member GET /admin-api/xacml/peps calls it. Send `pep` or `name`; both, they must name the same PEP. |
| `revokePrevious` | boolean |  | Revoke every other valid RFC 7523 key of the entry once this one is registered. Default false: a running PEP keeps its old key until it is moved onto this one. |

**200**: The key was certified and registered.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|

| `chainPem` | list |  | The Issuing CA and the realm Intermediate, leaf excluded. |

## GET /admin-api/xacml/monitor

`getXacmlMonitor`

**How many authorization decisions are being made, by which enforcement point, and how many are refusals**

Everything /admin/xacml/monitor draws: the global figures — policies, enforcement points, decisions, allows, declines — and then every PEP with its own counts, EMBEDDED and REMOTE in one list.

**A DECISION IS NOT AN ENFORCEMENT.** XACML has four decisions (Permit, Deny, NotApplicable, Indeterminate) and a PEP has two outcomes, and what maps between them is the PEP's BIAS: a deny-biased PEP refuses a NotApplicable that a permit-biased one allows, from the same decision on the same request. An obligation the PEP cannot discharge also turns a Permit into a refusal (section 7.2) — the one enforcement outcome that looks like a bug from the client side and is the specification working. So `allowed` is not `permit`, and both are reported.

**WHAT THIS SERVICE SAW IS NOT WHAT IT WAS TOLD.** `decisions.here` was counted by this process as it happened; `decisions.remote` is what registered PEPs REPORT on their heartbeats, cumulative in their own memory, and a PEP that restarts makes it go down. `decisions.combined` adds the two, which is the figure a deployment wants and is arithmetic over two kinds of evidence rather than a measurement.

**THE EMBEDDED PEPS ARE NOT "REGISTERED" AND CANNOT BE.** They are compiled into this process, so their existence is a fact about the build. A remote PEP registers because it has no other way to be known about — and even that is not a permission: an unregistered PEP can pull GET /xacml/pep/policies and enforce perfectly, and appears here nowhere. This is every enforcement point the service KNOWS ABOUT, which is a smaller claim than every one that exists.

The counters are IN MEMORY, start with the process (`since`) and are per trust realm. The durable record of a refusal is GET /admin-api/audit, which has the reason as well as the count.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/xacml/monitor` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |

| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |

## GET /admin-api/xacml/pep-clusters

`getXacmlPepClusters`

**The realm's remote PEP clusters: each one's shared configuration and its members**

Everything the PEP clusters tab on /admin/xacml and a cluster's own pages draw (#1760). A cluster's reverse proxy, managed settings and listener definitions are held once and every member pulls them as its own, differing only in its name and addresses. Each cluster carries its documents as the pull reads them, its routes' resolution and policy state, and each member's addresses, whether it is registered, and why a write would refuse it now (`code`, `why`). `peps` lists every registered PEP and its cluster, for the Members tab's chooser. With `cluster`, one cluster and `found`; with `route` as well, `routeDetail`.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/xacml, GET /admin/xacml/pep-cluster and GET /admin/xacml/pep-cluster/route` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | query | string |  | One cluster, by its name exactly. The answer then lists that cluster alone and says `found`. |
| `route` | query | string |  | With `cluster`: one route of the cluster's reverse proxy, by its id. The answer then carries `routeDetail`. |
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

## GET /admin-api/xacml/peps

`getXacmlPeps`

**The REMOTE Policy Enforcement Points that pull this repository, and whether they are deciding with the same policy this service holds**

Everything the Remote PEPs tab on /admin/xacml draws.

A REMOTE PEP runs in another process, holds its own copy of the engine and PULLS the enabled policies from GET /xacml/pep/policies. The pull is the contract; the nudge this service sends to `notifyUrl` when the repository changes is an optimisation over the polling interval and never a replacement for it, so a PEP that is never nudged still converges.

REGISTERING IS NOT A PERMISSION. An unregistered PEP can pull and enforce exactly as well — GET /xacml/pep/policies requires no credential, because a policy is a rule and a rule nobody can read is a rule nobody can check. What a row buys is this listing and an address for the nudge.

`current` is a COMPARISON this service performs between `syncToken` on the row and the repository's own, not a claim the PEP makes; `stale` is how long since it was last heard from against xacml.pepStaleAfterS and changes nothing this service does. The decision counts are the PEP's own, cumulative in its process — this service saw none of those decisions, which is what a remote PEP is — so a PEP that restarts makes them go down.

With `pep`, the answer is ONE PEP's page (#1760, `/admin/xacml/pep?pep=<name>`): `peps` holds that row alone and `found` says whether it is registered. Every answer carries `settingsCatalogue`: each setting an administrator may set for a remote PEP (its member name, the environment variable it replaces at the PEP, its type, bounds and closed set, its default, when a change takes effect, and whether this realm's mode refuses `true`), the environment variables that stay the PEP's own with why, and the precedence — the service's value, then the environment's, then the default. Each row carries `settings` (what is set here, null for none), `settingsProblem`, `settingsInUse` (what the PEP last reported having in force, by source) and `settingsCurrent` (whether that was applied from what would be sent now), and `effectiveNotifyUrl`, the address the nudge dials.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/xacml, GET /admin/xacml/pep, GET /admin/xacml/pep/route and GET /admin/xacml/pep/monitor` on the admin console.

The reply also carries `protocolEndpoints`: every endpoint of this family in the realm the call arrived in, as `{ name, methods, url }` (plus `route` for an HTTP endpoint, `transport` for a socket, and `registered: false` for a route the router no longer has).

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pep` | query | string |  | One registered PEP, by its name exactly. The answer then lists that row alone and says `found`; a name with no row answers 200 with `found: false`. |
| `route` | query | string |  | With `pep`: one route of that PEP's reverse proxy, by its id. The answer then carries `routeDetail`: the route, where it stands, whether its application resolves and which proxy listeners serve it; `found: false` there when the PEP has no such route. |
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**200**: The register, and what each PEP last reported.

## GET /admin-api/xacml/policies

`getXacmlPolicies`

**The policy repository, with the type-check problems of each**

Everything the Policies tab on /admin/xacml draws.

THE STORE IS `ou=policies` IN THE EMBEDDED DIRECTORY — that container IS the repository rather than a copy of one, so an `ldapmodify` of `xacmlPolicyDocument` changes what the PDP decides on the next request.

EXACTLY ONE POLICY IS THE ROOT. A PDP evaluates one document and reaches the rest through PolicyIdReference, so the root is where evaluation starts; a repository with none decides nothing and reports `root: null`.

`templates` is what POST /admin-api/xacml/create-from-template will build, with the parameters each takes.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/xacml` on the admin console.

The reply also carries `protocolEndpoints`: every endpoint of this family in the realm the call arrived in, as `{ name, methods, url }` (plus `route` for an HTTP endpoint, `transport` for a socket, and `registered: false` for a route the router no longer has).

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string |  | A search (#1760, the reverse-proxy route forms' policy chooser): a substring of a policy's name, PolicyId or description, without case. With q, per, page or routable the answer is that page of the matching policies, with matched, page and pages; with none of them, the whole repository. |
| `per` | query | integer |  | Policies per page of a search; 50 by default, capped at 300. |
| `page` | query | integer |  | Which page of a search. CLAMPED rather than refused: a page past the end returns the last one. |
| `routable` | query | one of `true`, `false` |  | true keeps only the policies a reverse-proxy route may choose: enabled, and sent to a remote PEP (not this service's own access or issuance policy, not an application's). |
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**200**: The policies, the root, and the templates.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `applicationPolicies` | list |  |  |
| `applicationPolicies[].application` | string |  |  |

| `applicationPolicies[].known` | boolean |  |  |

| `applicationPolicies[].policies[].name` | string |  |  |
| `applicationPolicies[].policies[].orphanedAt` | string, or null |  |  |
| `applicationPolicies[].policies[].policyId` | string, or null |  |  |
| `applicationPolicies[].policies[].referenced` | boolean |  |  |
| `applicationPolicies[].policies[].version` | string |  |  |
| `matched` | integer |  | A search's: how many policies matched. |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `page` | integer |  | A search's: the page these rows are, clamped. |
| `pages` | integer |  | A search's: how many pages the match has. |
| `policies` | list |  |  |
| `policies[].application` | string, or null |  |  |
| `policies[].combiningAlgId` | string |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/remove

`removeXacmlNode`

**Remove any node from a policy**

By `path`, which is the address GET /admin-api/xacml/editor gave you. A path is only valid against the document it was read from: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. Re-read the tree after each edit rather than reusing paths.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |
| `policy` | string | yes | The directory entry name of the policy to edit — the `cn` under ou=policies, not the PolicyId inside the document. |

**200**: The operation was applied.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `problems` | list |  |  |
| `problems[]` | string |  |  |
| `what` | string |  |  |
| `why` | string |  |  |

**400**: The operation was refused; `errors` says why and nothing changed.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `problems` | list |  |  |
| `problems[]` | string |  |  |
| `what` | string |  |  |
| `why` | string |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/remove-pep-cluster-member

`removeXacmlPepClusterMember`

**Remove a member from a remote PEP cluster**

Removes a member (#1760). By default (`keep` true) a registered member keeps a copy of the configuration it pulled as its own, its routes' policies generated again as pep-&lt;pep>-&lt;route>, and goes on enforcing it; with `keep` false it is left with none. Not a member is STS-XACML-0269.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `keep` | boolean, or string |  | Whether the member keeps a copy; true by default. |
| `pep` | string | yes | The member's name: a registered PEP's, or one not registered yet. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/remove-pep-cluster-route

`removeXacmlPepClusterRoute`

**Remove one route of a remote PEP cluster's reverse proxy**

The cluster's remove-pep-route (#1760): a route with a generated policy needs `removePolicy` true (STS-XACML-0268).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `removePolicy` | boolean, or string |  |  |
| `route` | string | yes |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/remove-pep-listener

`removeXacmlPepListener`

**Remove one of a remote PEP's defined listeners**

Removes a listener defined for a registered remote PEP (#1760); the PEP unbinds it on its next pull. The environment's four cannot be removed here (STS-XACML-0250).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listener` | string | yes | The listener's id. |
| `name` | string |  | The registered PEP's name, as GET /admin-api/xacml/peps lists it. |
| `pep` | string |  | The registered PEP's name under the member GET /admin-api/xacml/peps calls it, ?pep= (2026-11-14). Send `pep` or `name`; both, they must name the same PEP. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/remove-pep-route

`removeXacmlPepRoute`

**Remove one route of a remote PEP's reverse proxy**

Removes a route from a registered remote PEP's reverse-proxy configuration (#1760) and saves the document through set-pep-proxy's checks. An unknown route is STS-XACML-0230. A route with a policy generated for it (its authorization simple or public) is removed only with `removePolicy: true`, and the policy goes with it (STS-XACML-0268 otherwise).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/renew-pep-listener-certificate

`renewXacmlPepListenerCertificate`

**Have a remote PEP renew a defined HTTPS listener's certificate**

Moves the renewal counter of an HTTPS listener defined for a registered remote PEP (#1760): on its next pull the PEP generates a new key and asks POST /xacml/pep/listener-certificate for a new certificate, which supersedes the old one. A plain-HTTP listener or an unknown id is refused (STS-XACML-0250). The environment's HTTPS pair is issued with issue-pep-certificate.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-expression-apply

`setXacmlApply`

**Make an expression a function call**

Replaces whatever is at `path` with an `<Apply>` of the function named in `functionId`, with arguments the function's own signature requires. Every expression slot in a policy takes any of the four shapes, which is why these are four actions on one target rather than four kinds of node.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `functionId` | string |  | The function to apply. Its arguments are PRE-BUILT to the declared arity and types, so the expression typechecks the moment it exists. |
| `path` | string | yes | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |
| `policy` | string | yes | The directory entry name of the policy to edit — the `cn` under ou=policies, not the PolicyId inside the document. |

**200**: The operation was applied.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-expression-designator

`setXacmlDesignator`

**Make an expression an attribute reference**

An `<AttributeDesignator>`: reads an attribute out of the REQUEST, or out of the directory through the PIP when the id is a bare name or carries the `urn:sts:xacml:attribute:` prefix.

**IT RETURNS A BAG**, always, even when it finds exactly one value — which is why `string-one-and-only` exists and why most functions need it wrapped. Nothing in this engine ever holds a bare value, so there is no code path where somebody has to remember to wrap one.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

**Request body**

| `category` | string |  | The attribute category. Defaults to access-subject. |

| `path` | string | yes | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-expression-function

`setXacmlExpressionFunction`

**Replace an expression with a Function reference**

A function named as a VALUE rather than applied: `<Function FunctionId="..."/>`, which is what the first argument of a higher-order function such as `any-of`, `all-of` or `map` takes.

APPLYING IT THERE INSTEAD is the commonest way to write one of those wrongly, and it is why choosing a higher-order function from set-expression-apply now builds this shape for you rather than an AttributeValue the validator refuses.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-expression-selector

`setXacmlExpressionSelector`

**Replace an expression with an AttributeSelector**

An XPath over the `<Content>` of a request category, rather than a named attribute — and it returns a BAG exactly as a designator does, so most functions still need a `one-and-only` around it.

The namespace bindings its prefixes need TRAVEL WITH THE DOCUMENT: a prefix in the path means nothing without one, and an unresolvable prefix is an empty bag, which is NotApplicable, which looks exactly like a policy that decided you may not. Set them with edit-selector.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-expression-value

`setXacmlValue`

**Make an expression a literal**

An `<AttributeValue>` of `dataType` with `lexical` in it. The lexical form is parsed against the datatype when the policy is written, so `2026-13-01` as a date is refused there rather than becoming an Indeterminate at decision time.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lexical` | string |  | The value, in that datatype's lexical form. |
| `path` | string | yes | The node's address, from GET /admin-api/xacml/editor. ONLY VALID AGAINST THE DOCUMENT IT WAS READ FROM: remove rule 0 and every path naming rule 1 now means rule 0. |
| `policy` | string | yes | The directory entry name of the policy to edit — the `cn` under ou=policies, not the PolicyId inside the document. |
| `type` | string |  | The datatype URI. Defaults to xs:string. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-expression-variable

`setXacmlVariable`

**Make an expression a variable reference**

A `<VariableReference>` to a `<VariableDefinition>` in the same policy. The reference is checked at write time, so one naming a variable that is not there is refused rather than deciding Indeterminate.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-pep-cluster-listener

`setXacmlPepClusterListener`

**Define or replace one listener of a remote PEP cluster**

The cluster's set-pep-listener (#1760): the same grammar; each member's copy, with its own address, port and names, is checked against what that member reported (STS-XACML-0247 names the member).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string |  | The IPv4 or IPv6 address to bind; 0.0.0.0 or :: for every one. |
| `askClientCertificate` | boolean |  | Request a client certificate. Forced off for plain HTTP. |
| `ciphers` | string |  | TLS 1.2 ciphers, OpenSSL colon-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `disableTls12` | boolean |  | Refuse TLS 1.2. On by default, which forces TLSv1.3. |
| `dnsNames` | list, or string |  |  |
| `dnsNames[]` | string |  |  |
| `groups` | string |  | Key-exchange groups, OpenSSL colon-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `headersTimeoutS` | integer |  | Seconds to receive request headers. 0 means the keep-alive timeout plus one. |
| `http2` | boolean |  | Speak HTTP/2. Forced off for plain HTTP. |
| `http2MaxConcurrentStreams` | integer |  | Concurrent HTTP/2 streams on one connection. |
| `id` | string |  | The listener's id: 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, not one of the environment's four. An id already defined is replaced. |
| `ipAddresses` | list, or string |  |  |
| `ipAddresses[]` | string |  |  |
| `keepAliveTimeoutS` | integer |  | Idle keep-alive seconds before the connection closes. |
| `keyAlg` | one of `ec-p256`, `ec-p384`, `rsa-2048`, `rsa-3072` |  | HTTPS only: the key the PEP generates, ec-p256 by default. |
| `listener` | map, or string |  |  |
| `listener.{key}` | any JSON |  |  |
| `maxConnections` | integer |  | Open connections before further ones are refused. 0 is unlimited. |
| `maxRequestsPerSocket` | integer |  | Requests on one connection before it closes. 0 is unlimited. |
| `minVersion` | one of `TLSv1`, `TLSv1.1`, `TLSv1.2`, `TLSv1.3` |  | The minimum TLS version. disableTls12 or pqcOnly forces TLSv1.3. |
| `port` | integer |  | The port, 1 to 65535. |
| `pqcOnly` | boolean |  | Only post-quantum groups and the two 256-bit TLS 1.3 suites. Refused (STS-XACML-0281) when the chosen lists contain none. |
| `protocol` | one of `http`, `https` |  | http or https. |
| `purpose` | one of `api`, `proxy` |  | api or proxy. |
| `requireClientCertificate` | boolean |  | Refuse a handshake with no client certificate. Forced off for plain HTTP. |
| `sessionCacheSize` | integer |  | TLS session cache entries. 0 keeps none. |
| `sessionTimeoutS` | integer |  | TLS session lifetime in seconds. |
| `signatureAlgorithms` | string |  | Signature algorithms, colon-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `threadPoolMax` | integer |  | Workers this listener may grow to. At least the minimum. The reverse proxy's default is 128. |
| `threadPoolMin` | integer |  | Workers this listener starts with. At least 1. The reverse proxy's default is 16. |
| `tls13CipherSuites` | string |  | TLS 1.3 cipher suites, comma-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `trustAnchorsFile` | string |  | PEM file of client trust anchors on the PEP. Empty uses the PEP's own. |
| `trustIssuedClientCertificates` | boolean |  | Trust client certificates this realm's CA issued. |
| `tuning` | map |  | The same knobs as one object. Flat members win when both are sent. |
| `tuning.{key}` | any JSON |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-pep-cluster-member

`setXacmlPepClusterMember`

**Set a member's own addresses**

Replaces a member's own addresses (#1760): its publicBaseUrl, notify URL and listener addresses, each member given replacing the stored one. Checked as a cluster write is, for this member (STS-XACML-0277 for a shape, the grammar's and the resolution's own codes otherwise).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `listeners` | map, or string |  |  |
| `listeners.{key}` | any JSON |  |  |
| `notifyUrl` | string |  | The member's own notify URL, which the nudge dials; empty for the one it registered with. |
| `pep` | string | yes | The member's name: a registered PEP's, or one not registered yet. |
| `publicBaseUrl` | string |  | The member's own public base URL, the origin a browser reaches it at; empty for the cluster's. |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-pep-cluster-proxy

`setXacmlPepClusterProxy`

**Set a remote PEP cluster's reverse-proxy configuration**

The cluster's set-pep-proxy (#1760): the same document and grammar, its simple and public routes' policies generated as pepc-&lt;cluster>-&lt;route>. Its publicBaseUrl is the cluster's logical base URL: a simple or public route with no resource needs one (STS-XACML-0274). Every member's routes must resolve with its own callback; a session route with signals on is polled by each member on a stream of its own (X-Iya-Pep-Name). Every member is nudged.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `proxy` | map, or string | yes |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-pep-cluster-route

`setXacmlPepClusterRoute`

**Add or replace one route of a remote PEP cluster's reverse proxy**

The cluster's set-pep-route (#1760): `route` or the form's members, `from` for a rename, `part` for one tab of the route's page. Saved through set-pep-cluster-proxy's checks.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `from` | string |  |  |
| `part` | string |  |  |
| `position` | integer, or string |  |  |
| `route` | map, or string |  |  |
| `route.{key}` | any JSON |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-pep-cluster-settings

`setXacmlPepClusterSettings`

**Set a remote PEP cluster's managed settings**

The cluster's set-pep-settings (#1760): the same table, replacing what is set; every member pulls them. The notify URL is a member's address and is refused here (STS-XACML-0278).

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | string | yes | The cluster's name. |
| `settings` | map, or string |  |  |
| `settings.{key}` | any JSON |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/xacml/set-pep-environment-tuning

`setXacmlPepEnvironmentTuning`

**Set the TLS, HTTP and thread-pool tuning of one environment listener**

Sets the tuning of one of a registered remote PEP's four environment listeners (api-http, api-https, proxy-http, proxy-https) (#1760). The address, port and protocol stay the environment's. The PEP applies the tuning on its next pull. The same knobs as set-pep-listener: TLS, the session cache, HTTP pooling, HTTP/2, client certificates and the thread pool. The reverse proxy's pool is the largest by default. A value that does not fit is refused (STS-XACML-0281). A cluster has no single process, so this act is a PEP's, not a cluster's.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-policies, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-editor, POST /admin/xacml#xacml-tab-peps, POST /admin/xacml/policies, POST /admin/xacml/editor and POST /admin/xacml/peps` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DPoP` | header | string |  | RFC 9449: the proof of possession for a DPoP-bound access token, as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` requires. |
| `cell` | query | string |  | The cell to answer this request, where this service runs as several. Ignored in a service that runs as one. |

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `askClientCertificate` | boolean |  | Request a client certificate. Forced off for plain HTTP. |
| `ciphers` | string |  | TLS 1.2 ciphers, OpenSSL colon-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `disableTls12` | boolean |  | Refuse TLS 1.2. On by default, which forces TLSv1.3. |
| `groups` | string |  | Key-exchange groups, OpenSSL colon-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `headersTimeoutS` | integer |  | Seconds to receive request headers. 0 means the keep-alive timeout plus one. |
| `http2` | boolean |  | Speak HTTP/2. Forced off for plain HTTP. |
| `http2MaxConcurrentStreams` | integer |  | Concurrent HTTP/2 streams on one connection. |
| `keepAliveTimeoutS` | integer |  | Idle keep-alive seconds before the connection closes. |
| `listener` | string | yes | One of the environment's four: api-http, api-https, proxy-http or proxy-https. |
| `maxConnections` | integer |  | Open connections before further ones are refused. 0 is unlimited. |
| `maxRequestsPerSocket` | integer |  | Requests on one connection before it closes. 0 is unlimited. |
| `minVersion` | one of `TLSv1`, `TLSv1.1`, `TLSv1.2`, `TLSv1.3` |  | The minimum TLS version. disableTls12 or pqcOnly forces TLSv1.3. |
| `name` | string |  | The registered PEP's name, as GET /admin-api/xacml/peps lists it. |
| `pep` | string |  | The registered PEP's name under the member GET /admin-api/xacml/peps calls it, ?pep=. Send `pep` or `name`; both, they must name the same PEP. |
| `pqcOnly` | boolean |  | Only post-quantum groups and the two 256-bit TLS 1.3 suites. Refused (STS-XACML-0281) when the chosen lists contain none. |
| `requireClientCertificate` | boolean |  | Refuse a handshake with no client certificate. Forced off for plain HTTP. |
| `sessionCacheSize` | integer |  | TLS session cache entries. 0 keeps none. |
| `sessionTimeoutS` | integer |  | TLS session lifetime in seconds. |
| `signatureAlgorithms` | string |  | Signature algorithms, colon-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `threadPoolMax` | integer |  | Workers this listener may grow to. At least the minimum. The reverse proxy's default is 128. |
| `threadPoolMin` | integer |  | Workers this listener starts with. At least 1. The reverse proxy's default is 16. |
| `tls13CipherSuites` | string |  | TLS 1.3 cipher suites, comma-separated. Empty uses the built-in list. |
| `trustAnchorsFile` | string |  | PEM file of client trust anchors on the PEP. Empty uses the PEP's own. |
| `trustIssuedClientCertificates` | boolean |  | Trust client certificates this realm's CA issued. |
| `tuning` | map |  | The same knobs as one object. Flat members win when both are sent. |
| `tuning.{key}` | any JSON |  |  |

**200**: The operation was applied.
